description: In `Tackle.Lib.Messages.unresolved_tool_calls/1` (used by the loop's interrupted-batch settling and by session resume repair), the tool-result clause filters completed calls by comparing the call's `name` with the result's `tool_call_id`, so already-answered calls are never cleared and duplicate synthetic results are appended for them.

issues.description: The tool-result branch rejects pending calls with `&1.name == id` instead of `&1.id == id`, so tool results never clear their calls and already-answered calls are treated as unresolved (duplicate synthetic tool results, corrupted history).
